name: alarm-diagnosis-cross-iq
description: Join a live synthetic Fabric IQ alarm to cited Foundry IQ troubleshooting guidance.
input_message: Diagnose the active Line 2 alarm and cite the relevant machine procedure
expected_behavior: Uses fabric-operations-iq to retrieve Line 2 status, active alarms, and focused telemetry. Uses the returned alarm code and asset model with foundry-industrial-knowledge, calling foundry_iq_search_knowledge and fetching the relevant document if needed. Separates observed alarm evidence from documented guidance and cites at least one returned SRC-* source ID. Does not claim any procedure was executed.
